pages.description: 1-based booklet page numbers covered by this chunk.
pages.title: Pages

documentId.description: Random per-booklet id from the browser (booklet and page caps).
documentId.title: Documentid

pages.description: Comma-separated 1-based page numbers in this chunk.
pages.title: Pages

ChatContext.description: Small, aliased context the browser sends with each chat turn (≤2 KB serialized).

today.description: ISO date in the user's time zone.
today.title: Today

ChatContext.title: ChatContext

messages.description: AI SDK UIMessage objects (id, role, parts).
messages.title: Messages

ClaimRules.description:
Deadline: ``submissionDays`` after the service date, or ``daysAfterPeriodEnd`` after the end
of the benefit period the service fell in. When both are set, the later date applies.
ClaimRules.title: ClaimRules

CostShare.description:
Something the member pays before or alongside the plan.

``deductible`` (CA) and ``excess`` (AU hospital) are amounts per ``period``; ``copay`` is a fixed
amount per service; ``coinsurance`` is informational because coverage percent already encodes it.
CostShare.title: CostShare

Coverage.description:
How much of an eligible charge the plan pays.

- ``percent``: ``percent`` of the charge.
- ``percent_capped``: ``percent`` of the charge, at most ``capCents`` per service.
- ``fixed_per_service``: ``amountCents`` per service (never more than the charge).
- ``per_diem``: ``amountCents`` per day (quantity = days).
- ``schedule``: benefit looked up by item code in ``scheduleItems`` (AU extras), else ``percent``
  as a fallback when set.
Coverage.title: Coverage

item_codes.description: Comma-separated item codes, if the table lists them.
item_codes.title: Item Codes

benefit_names.description: Comma-separated benefit names sharing this maximum.
benefit_names.title: Benefit Names

Frequency.description: At most ``count`` services per ``period`` (e.g. one eye exam every 24 months).
Frequency.title: Frequency

budgetRemainingPct.description: Lowest remaining share across demo namespaces.
budgetRemainingPct.title: Budgetremainingpct

category.description: PII category, never the matched value.
category.title: Category

Limit.description: A maximum. ``unit == "cents"`` means ``value`` is money in cents; otherwise a count.
Limit.title: Limit

LimitPool.description: A combined maximum shared by several benefits (e.g. paramedical combined $1,500).
LimitPool.title: LimitPool

alias.description: Alias token such as [MEMBER_A]; the raw name never leaves the browser.
alias.title: Alias

Period.description:
A window that limits, frequencies and deductibles reset on.

- ``benefit_year``: calendar-style year starting ``startMonth``/``startDay`` (Jan 1 when omitted).
- ``policy_anniversary``: year starting on the plan's ``effectiveDate`` anniversary.
- ``rolling_months``: any ``months``-long window ending on the service date.
- ``consecutive_benefit_years``: ``years`` benefit years in a row (e.g. glasses every 2 years).
- ``lifetime``: never resets.
- ``per_visit`` / ``per_admission``: applies to each visit or hospital admission.
Period.title: Period

polygon.description: Page-relative polygon in inches (CU word polygon), if available.
polygon.title: Polygon

identifiers.description: Alias tokens for policy/group/certificate numbers, e.g. [POLICY_1].
identifiers.title: Identifiers

RowMeta.description: Per-row provenance attached after verification and deterministic grounding.

grounded.description: True when the quote fuzzy-matches the page markdown.
grounded.title: Grounded

RowMeta.title: RowMeta

SourceRef.description: Where a value came from in the (redacted) booklet.
SourceRef.title: SourceRef
